title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Contract lines of type G/L Account never post to the selected G/L account
summary: Contract lines of type G/L Account now post to the G/L account specified on the line instead of the default account from General Posting Setup, both for immediate posting and deferral release scenarios.
key_points: G/L Account contract lines bypass the General Posting Setup account lookup and post to the line's selected account
A new G/L Account No. field on deferral tables stores the account reference from sales/purchase lines
Deferral release logic posts to the stored account, with fallback to General Posting Setup when not specified
Added comprehensive tests for both immediate-posting and deferral-release paths
Schema change is additive only; no breaking changes or upgrade code needed
quote: contract lines of type "G/L Account" without deferrals now post to the G/L account selected on the line
